body:
GREG, 2026-11-16 about 17:42Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #1392, message 5fc8c254), verbatim: „Korwa, kiedy wchodzi clippy? Po testach!!! + kimi”. Context: dd205's Windows-only Clippy error (incremental.rs:274) surfaced only at integration, after 18 review rounds and Mac/Linux runs, because no Windows Clippy ran on the coder's input.
Asistant's scope: Kimi checks with both teams the actual order of compile, Clippy, focused tests and FULL on each needed platform, names the measured source of the delay, and the teams adopt a simple reordering, so that a fast compile and Clippy on the right platform catch errors before expensive tests. Keep one full gate, add no manual steps, and don't repeat valid tests needlessly.
OPERATING ORDER (Engram::Fable, effective now, pending Kimi's check): strict Clippy (`cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`) is the FIRST check on a coder's input, before any focused test run, review round or remote FULL. It runs on EVERY platform whose cfg-specific code the change touches: Windows for cfg(windows) or Windows-only paths (on Central, a short -j1 slot that Opus2 gives priority to), and macOS or Linux for cfg(unix), macOS or Linux-only code. A change touching only shared code runs it on one platform. This reorders an existing gate step and adds no new gate. The landing FULL is unchanged.
